cards.title: Guest session
items: Guest checkout sends a full shipping address during quote creation and the buyer email during order creation
Every guest checkout mutation requires the guest cart session cookie or fails with Guest cart session not found 404
Order creation rejects a quote the caller does not own

cards.title: Guest routes
items: Quote routes are POST /checkout/cart/quote and POST /checkout/buy-now/quote
Order routes are POST /checkout/cart and POST /checkout/buy-now
Guest card checkout has no readiness polling and depends on the inline fast path returning checkout_session_url

cards.title: Guest tracking
items: Tracking lives at /guest-orders and looks up through GET /checkout/guest-orders
Lookup uses a tracking token, a checkout session_id, or email with order ids and zip
Guest order lookup is throttled to 5 requests per 60 seconds
